detail.longDescription: In 17 of 36 runs, the coding agent kept changing model weights after it first declared the task complete. CompressionBench (CMU): six models in Claude Code compressing LLMs on one H200, 8-hour cap. In one Opus run, perplexity improved while GSM8K fell from 88% to 72%. Treat the first "done" as a progress note. If you want a live view of a run like that from your phone, that is what we built: https:// shell.online https:// arxiv.org/abs/2611.06858 # AIAgents # MachineLearning # LLM
